svg.title: Two skaters exchange a ball
svg.desc: A 60-kilogram skater throws a 5.0-kilogram ball at 6.0 meters per second and recoils; the second skater catches it and moves away. Momentum bars show the total stays zero. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Exchanging a ball pushes two skaters apart
60-kg skaters on frictionless ice; a 5.0-kg ball thrown at 6.0 m/s. A model of a repulsive force
carried by an exchanged object. The ball’s drop is not drawn.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
